purpose.text: Native Sun/Mon/Wed/Fri04:00 America/New_York: collect source evidence, plan and apply only reviewed A/S/W rules under disabled-by-default standing approval; hard40GiB and <=2h exact rules/manifest SHA binding. Manual per-run grant retained.

connects_to.name: config/disk_hygiene_rules.json
connects_to.source: every threshold, path and keep-count, re-read every run

connects_to.name: git (read-only, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0), du, crontab -l, systemd unit files, /proc/*/cwd
GitHub open PRs (sanctioned GET reader), coordination claims/worklogs/history, proc cwd/fds
connects_to.source: scripts/disk_hygiene.py collect_standing_evidence; unknown/refused evidence holds candidates

connects_to.name: reviewed A/S/W removal path, durable progress and per-run result reports
connects_to.source: scripts/disk_hygiene.py sole scoped removal implementation; enabled only after operator review

healthy.text: Fresh manifest, rules SHA, initial evidence and current per-item evidence agree; native run_id-bound v2 report is written, even for zero eligible items.
Before each removal a durable pending record exists; after removal its measured bytes/rule/result are durably recorded; unresolved pending state is not successful removal proof.
Per-rule planned/applied and eligible-unapplied bytes recorded; run-correlated digest intent queued by disk_usage_monitor. Operator delivery independently NOT_MEASURED.

degraded.text: Cap/revalidation holds eligible planned work; unknown size is NOT_MEASURED. Protected/recovery-point bytes are separate.
Disk used>85%; or eligible planned-unapplied>10GiB for two distinct known durable run IDs. Monitor crossing is measured independently of after-apply sample.

failed.text: RUN_FAILED/TIMEOUT/REFUSED; incomplete source/PR/ref evidence; changed rules/manifest/kill switch; removal/journal/report failure. Never report failure as zero-removal success.

baseline.freshness_rule: degraded beyond 2x cadence (lane_registry.evaluate_lane SLOW), failed beyond 3x (incident fan-in stale threshold)
baseline.source: PROPOSED 2x/3x of max48h native ET cadence; duration1440s/timeout1800s retained provisionally. No empirical acceptance asserted.

alerting.severity_basis: PROPOSED bounded cleanup and incomplete-source/receipt failures; direct sends remain forbidden; monitor host intent queues DIGEST/P2.
alerting.routing: SIEM row n8n:<lane> by scripts/n8n_siem_bridge.py; Telegram only through scripts/incident_notifier.py (P2 batched, held 22:00-07:00 ET, 24/day cap; P3 never sends). Never PAGE: the P1 path does not depend on n8n (AGENTS.md §24.1).
alerting.enforced: partial source integration: scripts/n8n_incident_fanin.py _wferr_severity() consumes a workflow contract's failed.notifier_priority to raise the workflow-error priority floor. scripts/lib/n8n_siem_bridge.py severity_for() uses registry severity, else the fan-in priority. Full per-lane baseline, notification and diagnosis enforcement is not established by these declarations; runtime coverage remains NOT_MEASURED (N8N_MONITORING_AND_REMEDIATION_STANDARD.md §7).

remediation.note: not in config/n8n_remediation_catalogue.json: the diagnoser skips it (lane_not_in_catalogue); regenerate with scripts/build_remediation_catalogue.py --write after the allowlist PR

verify: sqlite3 'file:$STATE_ROOT/data/governance/n8n_coordination_ledger.sqlite?mode=ro' "SELECT state, mode, started_at, duration_s, verdict FROM runs WHERE lane_id='disk-hygiene' ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 10"
evidence.never: an n8n execution status: successful executions are soft-deleted (EXECUTIONS_DATA_SAVE_ON_SUCCESS=none) and keep status 'running'; filter deletedAt IS NULL and prove work with the ledger
evidence.expected_output_basis: Native disk-hygiene v2 receipt:produced_count1 means durable result report written, not that all planned bytes were removed. Failure/refusal reports produced_count0.

state_note: PROPOSED standing A/S/W scope; operator apply review is pending. Existing plan-only review does not transfer.
